title: An Optimal Bound for Ramsey Goodness of Cycles
summary: For graphs $F$ and $H$, the Ramsey number $R(F,H)$ is the minimum integer $N$ such that every $N$-vertex graph contains $F$ or its complement contains $H$. If $F$ is connected and $|F|\geσ(H)$, a construction of Burr gives $R(F,H)\ge(χ(H)-1)(|F|-1)+σ(H)$, where $σ(H)$ denotes the minimum order of a color class in a proper $χ(H)$-coloring of $H$. Burr proved that this bound is attained for $F=C_n$ when $n$ is sufficiently large.
